title: GUACAMOLE STACK · Molecule tests (weekly)
description: Result of the last weekly Molecule run (play_weekly_molecule.sh, Thursday 0400, after the weekly builds) for the Guacamole stack: role-config = the Guacamole role on a Debian container; image-nucleus / image-ccop = the actual weekly images started on the role-staged config. Red = the latest weekly image or the role config broke (see /opt/ansible/molecule/logs/). Amber 'not reporting yet' = the scenario has not run or does not exist yet.

targets.expr: pipeline_weekly_molecule_status{stack="guacamole"} or on(test) label_replace(vector(-1), "test", "role-config", "", "") or on(test) label_replace(vector(-1), "test", "image-nucleus", "", "") or on(test) label_replace(vector(-1), "test", "image-ccop", "", "")
